The Blazor Web App builds successfully. Here's what was created:

**Project structure:**
```
RecipeCommunity/
├── Models/Recipe.cs          — Recipe & RecipeSubmission models
├── Services/RecipeService.cs — In-memory data store with 8 seed recipes
├── Components/Pages/
│   ├── Home.razor            — Homepage with category cards (static SSR)
│   ├── Categories.razor      — Browse recipes by category (static SSR)
│   ├── RecipeDetail.razor    — Full recipe view with ingredients & steps
│   ├── StarRating.razor      — Interactive 1–5 star rating widget (Server interactive)
│   └── SubmitRecipe.razor    — Recipe submission form (Server interactive)
```

**Key design decisions:**
- **Static SSR** for read-only pages (Home, Categories, Recipe Detail)
- **`@rendermode InteractiveServer`** only on the StarRating component and Submit form — the two parts needing interactivity
- 4 categories seeded: Italian, Indian, Mexican, Desserts (8 total recipes)
- Star rating uses hover effects and updates the average in real time
- Submit form validates all fields before enabling the submit button
